assumptions.warmup: Up to300 completed one-minute observations for every horizon; missing minutes are not filled.
assumptions.trend: The core uses seven prior observations and actual elapsed time. Scaling a short recent trend to long horizons is an assumption, not calibrated predictive evidence.
assumptions.timestamps: observedAt is local HTTP receipt time. exchangeTime is last-trade event time, not a separately timestamped order-book update.
assumptions.execution: Public snapshots are not executable orders. Paper fills omit latency, market impact and queue position.
